definitions.explanation: An official document acknowledging that payment has been received.

examples.japanese: {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: May I have a receipt, please?

examples.japanese: ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Receipts are needed for expense reimbursement.

examples.japanese: {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{宛名|あてな}→宛名：03995_atena⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had them write a name/address on the receipt.

notes:
{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ} is a compound: ⟦{領収|りょうしゅう}→領収：08640_ryoushuu⟧ (receipt of payment) + ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (document).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ} (formal receipt, often for business expenses)
- ⟦レシート→レシート：05291_reshiito⟧ (cash register receipt, informal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to get a receipt)
- {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧ (to issue a receipt)
- {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to write/issue a receipt)

JAPANESE RECEIPT FORMAT:
- ⟦{宛名|あてな}→宛名：03995_atena⟧ (recipient name - often 「⟦{上様|うえさま}→上様：noentry⟧」for anonymous)
- ⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧ (amount)
- ⟦{但|ただ}し{書|が}き→但し書き：15306_tadashigaki⟧ (description of goods/services)
- ⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧ (date)

CULTURAL NOTE:
「⟦{上様|うえさま}→上様：noentry⟧」is commonly written as recipient name when specific name isn't needed.
